name: Bun ca ngu
summary: Vietnam Airlines describes bún cá ngừ um, tuna braised with turmeric and chili and poured over noodles. ZaloPay describes bún cá ngừ as a clear bone broth with tomato and pineapple. The two bowls are both printed.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the braise rich and hot, and the bowl yellow and fragrant. ZaloPay calls the broth clear and lightly sweet, and the tuna firm.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: fresh tuna cut into pieces, braised soft with turmeric, chili, and pure fish sauce, then poured over fresh rice noodles. Eat it with herbs and grilled sesame rice paper. It calls the bowl breakfast or a light lunch.
ZaloPay: a clear broth from fish bones, thick tuna slices, tomato, pineapple, and a little turmeric, with herbs, scallion, and green chili. It also calls the bowl breakfast or a light lunch.
No street was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Vietnam Airlines and ZaloPay name no street.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints from 25,000 VND a bowl. ZaloPay printed no price.
seoTitle: Bun ca ngu in Quang Ngai — two tuna bowls
seoDescription: Vietnam Airlines braises tuna with turmeric for bún cá ngừ um, from 25,000 VND. ZaloPay describes a clear broth with tomato and pineapple. The hour is Check on arrival.
